title: FC 6002: Definitions
officialText:
6002.1 Definitions.

The following terms shall, for the purposes of this chapter and as used elsewhere in this code, have the meanings set forth in FC 202.

CONTAINMENT SYSTEM.

CONTAINMENT VESSEL.

EXCESS FLOW VALVE.

HIGHLY TOXIC MATERIAL.

OZONE GAS GENERATOR.

REDUCED FLOW VALVE.

TOXIC MATERIAL.
